During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a group of freelance agents from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;ventured to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kemix]] on a '''mission''' to cripple a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] venture established by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Riboga]] on the world and to rescue the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Tarasin]] [[Force Adept]]s [[Krizta]] and [[Trik]].
